distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: One thing I remember: this all started right after we had a power outage last week.
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have that detail available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, my router keeps dropping the connection every few minutes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. How long has this been happening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: About a week now. I work from home, so it is disruptive.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the unit itself ever lose power?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, it never fully turns off.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do all devices drop at the same time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. Phones, TV, and laptop all lose it together.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can another nearby customer on the same service connect normally?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, my neighbor uses the same provider and hers is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the issue on wireless only, or wired too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Both. Even my desktop on ethernet loses connection.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you moved it away from possible wireless interference?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, and that made no difference.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you tried restarting the router?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I restarted it once already. It came back up but still drops.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What do the lights do when the connection drops?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The internet light goes orange for a bit, then back to green.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did your provider report a service interruption?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Their status page shows nothing in my area.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have any cables or ports been changed recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, the cabling is exactly as it was before.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was there any event around the time the problem first began?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One thing I remember: this all started right after we had a power outage last week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Begin the guided software maintenance procedure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I have followed that step.

firmware_status.not_started: the maintenance update has not begun
firmware_status.updating: the update is actively progressing within its expected window
firmware_status.stuck: the update remains incomplete after the expected progress window
firmware_status.interrupted: the update began but was stopped before completion

pre_gap_actions.description: Begin the guided software maintenance procedure.
Run the basic power recovery procedure one more time.
Investigate the upstream service path before changing the device.
Escalate immediately to a hardware replacement.
Close the case and ask the user to monitor it independently.

post_gap_actions.description: Inspect persistent device settings for an inconsistent state.
Run the guided software maintenance procedure now.
Repeat the basic power recovery procedure.
Leave the current process alone and monitor it for another interval.
Close the case because sufficient time has passed.

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: What event happened when the router problem began?
Had the router already been restarted?
What percentage did the maintenance reach?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
